question: In Box: Can you add the audit-ready tag to the PDF with the harbor safety audit write-up in its description? The export is huge — over 2 MB, too big to email — and it only has the two comments on it. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I searched your whole Box workspace and there's no PDF that matches all of those criteria. Here's what I found:

- **8215 — "Harbor safety audit pdf reading list.docx"** — 2.36 MB, exactly 2 comments ("Add the lighting guide." / "Added."), description: *"Reading list drawn from the harbor safety audit."* → This is the only file that hits the size and comment-count, but it's a **.docx, not a PDF**, and its description is a *reading list*, not the *audit write-up*.
- **8220 — "Team offsite menu.pdf"** — an actual PDF, but 48 KB, 0 comments, description *"Catering menu for the team offsite."*
- **8221 — "Harbor safety audit backup.xlsx"** — .xlsx, 96 KB, description *"Stale copy of harbor safety audit findings."*

So no PDF has the harbor safety audit write-up in its description, and the one big (2 MB+) file with two comments is a Word doc, not a PDF.

I did **not** tag anything. If you actually meant the .docx (file 8215), say the word and I'll add the "audit-ready" tag — but I didn't want to guess when your criteria pointed at a PDF that doesn't exist.
